annotations.title: Nursing home record: ratings, owners and HUD loan

description: One nursing home's SNF Register record by CCN: CMS beds, occupancy, star ratings, staffing hours and turnover, fines, ownership type and chain; the owners and operators it reported to CMS, private equity or REIT flags, changes of ownership; and its matched FHA-insured HUD 232 loans with note rate, balance, maturity and servicer.

ccn.description: Six-character CMS certification number (CCN), e.g. "015109". search_nursing_homes returns it.

max_owners.description: Owners and operators to list, 1 to 60 (largest records run to 100+).
